text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A repeatedly just because it showed a large gain may have reduced my exposure to a winning investment; I should decide whether to sell based on a portfolio plan, not my cost basis.","I made no trades during the later decline, but inactivity is not automatically wise; I should review whether my holdings and risk still fit my goals without reacting to random price swings.","My account value fell from its peak despite earlier gains, reminding me that realized profits do not eliminate portfolio risk; I should diversify and manage position sizes consistently."]}
